title: Nick Bosa set to return to 49ers for Week 1 game vs. Rams in Australia

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Nick Bosa set to return to 49ers for Week 1 game vs. Rams in Australia
sources.description: The 49ers got some much-needed good news going into Week 1 of the NFL season. Defensive star Nick Bosa is set to suit up against the Rams.
